evidence: gpt-oss-120b tries colors in `(1, 2, 3)` and checks `ok`; deepseek-v4-flash rejects `if color[nb] == c`; glm-5 explicitly lists `forbidden (1,1)`, `(2,2)`, `(3,3)`
affordance_in_statement: Each oscillator is assigned a multiplier from `{1, 2, 3}`, and for a linked pair the signature is `R = 2^{s_u} + 2^{s_v}`; this signature must not be a perfect power of 2.
secondary_shortcut_name: plain exponential DFS with vertex-order lexicographic search
removal_suggestion: Do not expose a uniform equality constraint through the power-of-two formulation; instead make the link stability rule depend on an additional link-specific or endpoint-specific condition, while preserving the shown examples.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Treats the task as assigning one of three colors while forbidding equal colors on adjacent vertices, using color-ordered DFS.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The sum of two allowed powers of 2 is a power of 2 exactly when the two exponents are equal.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Checks only whether an already-colored neighbor has the same value: `if color[nb] == c`.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The resonance condition reduces every edge to the inequality constraint `s_u != s_v`.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Explicitly derives the forbidden pairs as `(1,1)`, `(2,2)`, and `(3,3)`, then performs three-coloring DFS.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The allowed multiplier set is exactly `{1,2,3}` and equal exponents produce powers of two.

common_affordance: The algebraic resonance rule collapses to the uniform edge constraint s_u != s_v, making the problem ordinary graph 3-coloring.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Enumerates all 3^n assignments with `itertools.product`, so it times out near the upper bound instead of using constraint-directed search.

recommended_edit: Replace the uniform condition that `2^{s_u}+2^{s_v}` must not be a power of 2 with a nonuniform link-stability rule whose forbidden multiplier pairs depend on the link or its endpoints; this directly invalidates the all-equal-is-the-only-forbidden-pair assumption used by every survivor.
regression_risk: This changes the core coloring structure and could make the previously TLE brute-force model pass on instances that become easier; preserve hard nonuniform instances in the tests.
